title: Error code 0x8007042B -- VPN Client
text:
Error code 0x8007042B (VPN Client).
Cause: Tunnel negotiation failed after successful authentication
Fix: Update VPN client to the gateway's currently supported version; if already current check local firewall/antivirus is not blocking the tunnel's assigned port.

title: Error code 0x800B0109 -- VPN Client
text:
Error code 0x800B0109 (VPN Client).
Cause: Gateway certificate is untrusted or expired on the client machine
Fix: Reinstall the corporate root certificate bundle via the standard endpoint management push; do not have the user manually trust the cert.

title: Error code 0x80090326 -- VPN Client
text:
Error code 0x80090326 (VPN Client).
Cause: TLS handshake failure between client and gateway
Fix: Check client OS TLS version support; gateways deprecated TLS 1.0/1.1 support in the last major firmware update.

title: Error code 809 -- VPN Client
text:
Error code 809 (VPN Client).
Cause: IKEv2 traffic blocked by an intermediate firewall or NAT device
Fix: Confirm UDP 500/4500 and ESP protocol are not blocked on the user's network; common on hotel and public Wi-Fi.

title: Error code LIC-EXP-02 -- Design Software License Manager
text:
Error code LIC-EXP-02 (Design Software License Manager).
Cause: Floating license lease expired and failed to auto-renew from the license server
Fix: Have the user reconnect to the corporate network and relaunch the app; if it recurs check the license server's lease pool isn't exhausted.

title: Error code APP-DEADLOCK-11 -- Internal Application Runtime
text:
Error code APP-DEADLOCK-11 (Internal Application Runtime).
Cause: Two application threads are holding locks the other needs, causing a permanent freeze
Fix: Force-close and restart the application; if it recurs on the same workflow step, escalate with the exact step for the dev team to inspect the lock order.

title: Error code DEPLOY-FAIL-07 -- CI/CD Deployment Pipeline
text:
Error code DEPLOY-FAIL-07 (CI/CD Deployment Pipeline).
Cause: Application crashed mid-deploy due to a missing environment variable in the target environment
Fix: Check the target environment's config against the deployment checklist for missing/renamed environment variables before retrying the deploy.

title: Error code DHCP-TIMEOUT-03 -- Network DHCP Service
text:
Error code DHCP-TIMEOUT-03 (Network DHCP Service).
Cause: Client did not receive a lease response before the DHCP request timed out
Fix: Confirm the DHCP scope for that subnet isn't exhausted; have the user release/renew, and check the switch port's VLAN assignment if it persists.

title: Error code NET-DUPIP-04 -- Network Layer (ARP)
text:
Error code NET-DUPIP-04 (Network Layer (ARP)).
Cause: Two devices on the same subnet were assigned the same static or leased IP address
Fix: Identify the conflicting device via ARP table lookup and release/reassign one of the two IPs; do not have the user simply reboot repeatedly.

title: Error code LAT-SPIKE-09 -- Network QoS Monitoring
text:
Error code LAT-SPIKE-09 (Network QoS Monitoring).
Cause: Intermittent latency spikes correlated with a saturated uplink during peak hours
Fix: Check the switch's uplink utilization graphs for the affected time window before assuming a client-side issue; escalate to network engineering if uplink is saturated.

title: Error code SWPORT-ERR-812 -- Network Switch
text:
Error code SWPORT-ERR-812 (Network Switch).
Cause: Physical switch port entered an error-disabled state after repeated link flapping
Fix: Have facilities check the physical cable/connector first; if clean, the port needs to be re-enabled from the switch admin console -- do not swap the user's machine first.
